top_signals.title: Gold Wavers as High Oil Prices, Inflation Bolster Rate-Hike Bets
top_signals.summary: Gold wavered, as surging oil prices and the latest US inflation report bolstered the case for the Federal Reserve to hike interest rates next week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
